title: next/image quality prop is ignored on Next.js 16 and direct /_next/image?q=90 requests return 400
symptoms: An Image with quality={90} is served at q=75
cause: Next.js 16 changed the default images.qualities from any value to only [75]. Unlisted quality values are snapped to the nearest allowed one, and the optimizer rejects unlisted q values.
fix: List every quality you use in images.qualities.
